Item.Name: UNIT_ID
Item.Hint: Press [ENTER] to continue; [PRVFLD] to change Unit ID

Trigger.Name: VALIDATE_FIELD
Trigger.TriggerText:
declare
 number_of_splits_on_bags number;
 temp_count number;
 temp_batch_id VARCHAR2(14);
 temp_unit VARCHAR2(15);
begin
 nullchk;
 check_package_failure;
 :ctrl_blk_1.s_chapter_id := :GLOBAL.chapter_id;
 begin
 select max(coll_date) into :ctrl_blk_1.coll_date
 from units
 where unit_id = :ctrl_blk_1.unit_id and
 chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id;
 if :ctrl_blk_1.coll_date is null
 then
 GO_ITEM('s_unit_id');
 CLEAR_ITEM;
 show_error('0063');
 check_package_failure;
 end if;
 exception
 when OTHERS
 then
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end;
 begin
 --
 -- Check if there is any component can be split
 --
 select distinct 'x' into :GLOBAL.x
 from valid_products v
 where sysdate between eff_date and
 nvl(term_date,sysdate+365)
 --- and product_type != 'CRYO'
 and 1 <= (select count(*)
 from components
 where unit_id = :ctrl_blk_1.unit_id
 and trunc(coll_date) =
 trunc(:ctrl_blk_1.coll_date)
 and product_code = v.product_code
 and chapter_id = :ctrl_blk_1.s_chapter_id
 and component_status = 'L'
 and reject_reason_code is null)
 and
 0 < (select sum(nvl(number_of_bags,0) -
 nvl(bags_used,0))
 from unit_add_on_bags
 where unit_id = :ctrl_blk_1.unit_id and
 chapter_id = :ctrl_blk_1.s_chapter_id and
 trunc(coll_date) =
 trunc(:ctrl_blk_1.coll_date) and
 product_code = v.product_code);
 exception
 when NO_DATA_FOUND
 then
 :GLOBAL.user_err_unit_id := :ctrl_blk_1.unit_id;
 :GLOBAL.user_err_chapter_id := :GLOBAL.chapter_id;
 :GLOBAL.user_err_coll_date := :ctrl_blk_1.coll_date;
 GO_ITEM('s_unit_id');
 CLEAR_ITEM;
 show_error('0132');
 check_package_failure;
 when OTHERS
 then
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end;
 default_value('','GLOBAL.bag_code');
 reconcile_bags(:ctrl_blk_1.unit_id,:ctrl_blk_1.coll_date,
 :GLOBAL.chapter_id,
 number_of_splits_on_bags,
 :GLOBAL.bag_code);
 check_package_failure;
 if number_of_splits_on_bags < 1
 then
 GO_ITEM('s_unit_id');
 CLEAR_ITEM;
 :GLOBAL.user_err_unit_id := :ctrl_blk_1.unit_id;
 :GLOBAL.user_err_chapter_id := :GLOBAL.chapter_id;
 :GLOBAL.user_err_coll_date := :ctrl_blk_1.coll_date;
 show_error('0135');
 check_package_Failure;
 end if;
end;

Trigger.TriggerText:
declare
 temp_product_code VARCHAR2(5);
 temp_product_code_desc VARCHAR2(50);
begin
 nullchk;

 if :ctrl_blk_1.s_product_code != 'M'

Trigger.Name: VALIDATE_FIELD
Trigger.TriggerText:
declare
 temp_count number;
begin
 nullchk;
 check_package_failure;
 CHECK_INTRANSIT_INTERDICTION (:ctrl_blk_1.unit_id,
 :ctrl_blk_1.coll_date,
 :GLOBAL.chapter_id,
 :ctrl_blk_1.product_code,
 null,
 :GLOBAL.warehouse,
 'INTR');
 begin
 select product_code, product_desc
 into :ctrl_blk_1.product_code,
 :ctrl_blk_1.s_product_code_desc
 from valid_products
 where product_code = :ctrl_blk_1.product_code
 ---- and product_type != 'CRYO'
 and 1 <= (select count(*)
 from components
 where unit_id = :ctrl_blk_1.unit_id
 and trunc(coll_date) =
 trunc(:ctrl_blk_1.coll_date)
 and product_code = valid_products.product_code
 and chapter_id = :ctrl_blk_1.s_chapter_id
 and component_status = 'L'
 and reject_reason_code is null)
 and sysdate between eff_date and
 nvl(term_date,sysdate+365);
 exception
 when NO_DATA_FOUND
 then
 :ctrl_blk_1.s_product_code_desc := '';
 show_error('1205');
 check_package_failure;
 when OTHERS
 then
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end;
 begin
 select sum(nvl(number_of_bags,0) - nvl(bags_used,0))
 into temp_count
 from unit_add_on_bags
 where unit_id = :unit_id and
 chapter_id = :s_chapter_id and
 trunc(coll_date) = trunc(:coll_date) and
 product_code = :product_code;
 if temp_count < 0
 then
 :GLOBAL.user_err_unit_id := :unit_id;
 :GLOBAL.user_err_chapter_id := :GLOBAL.chapter_id;
 :GLOBAL.user_err_coll_date := :coll_date;
 :GLOBAL.user_err_product_code := :product_code;
 show_error('0011');
 check_package_failure;
 end if;
 exception
 when OTHERS
 then
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end;
end;

Item.Name: BAG_ID
Item.Hint: Enter value for bag plastic ID or use [LISTVAL]

Trigger.Name: KEY-NEXT-ITEM
Trigger.TriggerText:
declare
 temp_count number;
 temp_component_prefix number;
 temp_warehouse varchar(10);
begin
 execute_trigger('validate_field');
 check_package_failure;
 temp_warehouse := :GLOBAL.warehouse;
 :system.message_level := 5;
 savepoint all_clear;
 begin
 select to_number(max(component_prefix))+1
 into temp_component_prefix
 from components
 where unit_id = :ctrl_blk_1.unit_id and
 trunc(coll_Date) = trunc(:ctrl_blk_1.coll_date) and
 chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id and
 product_code = :ctrl_blk_1.product_code;
 exception
 when OTHERS
 then
 message('Error in selecting from components');
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end;
 :s_aliquot_number := temp_component_prefix;
 begin
 insert into components
 (warehouse_id, unit_id, coll_date, chapter_id, insert_dats,
 component_prefix, product_code, bag_id,
 component_status, program_id)
 values
 (temp_warehouse, :ctrl_blk_1.unit_id, :ctrl_blk_1.coll_date,
 :GLOBAL.chapter_id, sysdate,
 temp_component_prefix, :ctrl_blk_1.product_code,
 :ctrl_blk_1.bag_id, 'L', :banner.prog_name);
 exception
 when OTHERS
 then
 message('Error in inserting in components');
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end;
 begin
 update unit_add_on_bags
 set bags_used = nvl(bags_used,0)+1,
 program_id = :banner.prog_name
 where unit_id = :unit_id and
 trunc(coll_date) = trunc(:coll_date) and
 chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id and
 product_code = :product_code and
 sdc_ws_number =
 (select sdc_ws_number
 from unit_add_on_bags
 where unit_id = :unit_id and
 trunc(coll_date) = trunc(:coll_date) and
 chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id and
 product_code = :product_code and
 nvl(number_of_bags,0)-nvl(bags_used,0)>0
 and rownum < 2);
 exception
 when OTHERS
 then
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end;
 commit;
 :system.message_level := 0;
 if form_failure
 then
 clear_form(full_rollback);
 execute_trigger('key-clrfrm');
 show_error('0230');
 check_package_failure;
 else
 show_error('8010');
 check_package_failure;
 down;
 end if;
end;

 begin

 exception
 when NO_DATA_FOUND
 then
